items.heading: Cou-Cou and Flying Fish
details: Key ingredients: cornmeal, okra, flying fish, tomato, lime
Cook cornmeal with sliced okra, stirring into a smooth firm mash.
Season flying fish fillets with lime and herbs.
Steam or saute the fish in a light tomato-based sauce.
Serve the cou-cou molded alongside the seasoned fish.

items.heading: Macaroni Pie
details: Key ingredients: macaroni, cheese, eggs, milk, mustard
Boil macaroni until just tender.
Mix with beaten eggs, milk, mustard and a generous amount of cheese.
Pour into a baking dish and top with more cheese.
Bake until set and golden on top.
